These workshops are part of a series focused on Cardano development under CardanoCodex’23. Reputed founders, developers, and mentors from the Cardano ecosystem have conducted these workshops for CardanoCodex’23. Two workshops have already been conducted, and two more are scheduled. We are submitting the PoA considering the approaching deadline.

ms.report:
1. Detailed Submission Guidelines for Participants
・Available on Website: The CardanoCodex hackathon website was updated with detailed submission guidelines for participants. These guidelines include information on eligibility, project requirements, submission formats, deadlines, and criteria for evaluation.
・Link: https://cardanocodex23.com/

2. Setting Up the GitHub Repository
・Repository Name: CardanoCodex'23-2K23
・URL: CardanoCodex-23 Repository

3. Evaluation and Selection of Winners
・Evaluation Process: Projects were thoroughly evaluated based on innovation, practicality, impact, and utilization of Cardano’s tech stack.
・Winners:
・🥇 CardaClub: A NFT-based platform designed by Team Vinayek to enhance the student club experience through simplified membership, management, and fundraising processes.
・Link: https://github.com/vinayeks/CardanoCodex-23/tree/main/Vinayek
・🥈 PullPay ADA: Developed by Team TahaaCode, this project introduces a URL-based payment solution for ADA transactions, aiming to simplify financial management for organizations.
・Link: https://github.com/tahaaaaa13/CardanoCodex-23/tree/main/TahaaCode
・🥉 College Piggy Bank: A decentralized tool by Team UV focused on promoting financial literacy among students for managing college expenses.
・Link: https://github.com/gyuvann/CardanoCodex-23/tree/main/Team%20UV/clg-fee-piggy-bank 

4. Project Outcomes and Success Stories
・CardaClub: Revolutionizes student engagement in extracurricular activities, offering a novel approach to club membership and fundraising.
・PullPay ADA: Showcases the flexibility of the Cardano blockchain for secure and efficient transaction processing, enhancing organizational financial operations.
・College Piggy Bank: Empowers students with financial literacy, encouraging smart saving and investing for college expense management.

5. Project Closure Report, Project completion video and Virtual Event for Results Announcement and Prize Distribution
